title: Dynamic Merchant/Source Title Label with Quick Chips & Cute 3D Category Dropdown Selector
objective: Improve the Transaction Verification modal UX: dynamically switch merchant label to 'ที่มาของรายรับ / รายการ *' with quick chips (เงินเดือน, ปันผล, etc.) when transaction is an Income, and replace the dual category pickers with a unified custom cute 3D Dropdown Selector displaying vibrant 3D category icons.
user_story: As a user recording transactions, I want the merchant field to intelligently adapt when recording salary/income without confusing merchant terms, and I want a single cute 3D dropdown to select categories easily.
acceptance_criteria: Merchant field label and placeholder adapt dynamically based on transaction type (Expense: 'ร้านค้า / ผู้รับเงิน *' vs Income: 'ที่มาของรายรับ / รายการ *')
Income transactions display quick chips for instant autofill (เงินเดือน, ปันผล, โบนัส, คืนเงิน)
Category selection is unified into a single custom Cute 3D Dropdown with 3D icons, clean animations and smooth selection
Hidden native select remains bound for full backward compatibility with test suites and form validation
All 42 automated tests continue to pass with exit code 0
